title: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: Application of Lien-Sale Proceeds and Surplus
content:
**Rule.** Net proceeds of a lien sale on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, after the sale costs already posted as lien-process fees, are applied against the rental's balance due up to that balance, and never beyond it. Any surplus is not credited to the ledger; it is held for the former tenant for the class's surplus hold period in calendar days after the sale date and released only on a written claim handled by the facility district office. A balance still owed after the proceeds are applied stays owed by the former tenant. Once sold, a rental is never redeemed, transferred or reopened.

## Outcomes by size of the net proceeds

| Net proceeds compared with the balance due | Applied to the ledger | Held as surplus | Still owed by the former tenant |
|---|---|---|---|
| less than the balance | all of the proceeds | nothing | the balance less the proceeds |
| equal to the balance | all of the proceeds | nothing | nothing |
| more than the balance | the balance | the excess | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Balance due $640.00, net proceeds $500.00: $500.00 is applied and $140.00 stays owed.
- Balance due $640.00, net proceeds $900.00: $640.00 is applied and $260.00 is held as surplus for the former tenant, released only on a written claim handled by the facility district office.
